title: Asirgarh Fort

terrainReference.basis: Original elevation at the summit placement anchor.

mapIdentity.provider: OpenStreetMap named Asirgarh Fort summit and reservoirs.
mapIdentity.scope: OpenStreetMap way 379876762 traces 74 controls of the named summit fort. Mapped node 9510021028 locates an upper gate, and three mapped ponds locate the larger reservoir embankments. The matched 1880 Asirgad plate constrains lower west wall lines and interior layout.

note: The 1880 government field account describes rough fourteen-foot summit walls and round towers above the scarp. The Indian cultural resource survey records three levels and a stepped western gateway with a pointed arch. The Archaeological Survey identifies the twin-minaret black-stone mosque and the triple-arched gate to its courtyard.
